editorial.blurb: A lively Chicago pub where crispy fish and chips, comforting British pies, and silky bread pudding arrive fast and generous—perfect for catching the game or warming up by the window.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early on game days for a good view and note they don't honor happy hour during World Cup matches; ask for a window seat if you can.

topDishes.note: Crispy, fresh, perfectly paired with tartar sauce and lemon
Silky and delicious, a standout staff recommendation
A favorite from the Wee Pie Flight, nicely plated and comforting
